Gielen, D. and Moriguchi, Y. (2002). CO2 in the iron and steel industry: an analysis of Japanese emission reduction potentials. Energy Policy 30(10), 849-863. PII S0301-4215(01)00143-4 (DOI 10.1016/S0301-4215(01)00143-4).

Region Japan, base year 1999. Locators are printed journal page numbers (849-863). Thin source for technology data: it is a model paper (STEAP). Loaded: Corex coal input, gas-based DRI energy, BF-gas combined cycle efficiency, BF and EAF energy per t derived from Table 2 (statistics of the whole industry divided by output; low trust), and the Table 7 abatement costs (yen of 2000 per t CO2 relative to BAU). Not loaded: Table 5 primary-energy figures (other-values), Table 2/4 totals, national potentials in Mt CO2, model sensitivity runs. TRAPS: Table 2 column totals for BF/BOF/EAF/power/coke are net of by-product gas credits so carrier rows do not sum to them; all energy is LHV although source statistics are HHV; costs have no capex data, no cost basis; Table 3 header says kg CO2/GJ but values are t CO2/GJ; EAF scrap CO2 printed 0.3 kg/t (typo). The STEAP model data are said to be available at the EMP website (not held).
